text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Daiwa Scarlet by the school gates
one
weekend.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I can't wait for our lunch together, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I hope you like the place I chose!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, hi Trai—I mean, hello, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hiya! Me and Scarlet are just about to
go to
lunch!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Since you're here, why don't you join us?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If Spe's okay with it, then I don't mind at
all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet agrees with a smile, but
suddenly
steps close and whispers
something in my ear.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm sure this goes without saying, but you better be on your best behavior in front of Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Nope, nothing at all! ♪ Shall we get
going then?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I tag along, slightly
bewildered by
how polite Scarlet sounds
when she's not talking
to me.

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk A
text_block_list.text:
Order up! One hamburger steak meat
mountain
platter for three!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This is what I was telling you about!
Ooh, looks
good!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... So, this is... what you like to
eat...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A giant slab of hamburger steak, a huge
side of
sautéed vegetables, and a
mountain of rice
covers the entire table.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let's dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Special Week excitedly starts eating,
Daiwa
Scarlet whispers to me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Spe ordered this especially for us. It'd
be rude to
not finish it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You'd better be ready for this! We can't
leave a
single crumb on our plates!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, good plan. We'll crush it in one fell
swoop!
choice_data_list: 満腹感を覚える前に一気に食べ切ろう……！
野菜から順番に、確実に攻めよう……！

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: W-we finished...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow! You both finished everything!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you finished before me!
You must
have really liked it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, it was... very delicious. ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm about finished too! Man, that was
finger-lick'n
great!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I end up with a terrible stomachache
from eating
too fast, and I head back to
campus clutching my
gut.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Good plan. We go at it slow and steady
so we
have time to properly digest and
finish it off!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Finished! Ahh... As always, that was
finger-lick'n
great!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry! Where are my manners? You
two are
still eating.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I-incredible, Spe. You cleaned that plate
fast, but
we're not far behind...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Gulp!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: F-finished...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You two finished everything! You
liked it
that much?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, it was... very delicious. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The meal keeps me full all day, even
long after
the sun sets.
